approved_by_user: 2026-11-08 ("I approve proceeding with M2 and M3")
evidence_label: VALIDATION scoring; all fitting and C selection on TRAIN; test rows dropped on load (GoT cache file is combined) and never used

questions.SQ2: Per layer x architecture x task: is task information in the SAE reconstruction preserved, only shifted in readout, reduced for some probe families, or not recovered by any tested family; and is the loss SAE-specific (vs noise) and worse or better than PCA at the same OWT error?

tasks.got_cities: GoT cities + neg_cities (geographic), existing grouped split, final token
tasks.repe_persona: M1 RepE-LM T1-T4, variants H/U, final token, statement-grouped
tasks.repe_neutral: M1 RepE-LM N1-N2 (tall/short, red/blue), final token: ALWAYS reported beside persona

sources.sae: 108 uninterrupted OWT SAEs (layer-0 JumpReLU seed 42 flagged unmatched; excluded from summaries)
sources.pca: PCA on OWT TRAIN activations (101,600 tokens, BOS excluded), one per layer x architecture: k = smallest with OWT VALIDATION NMSE <= that architecture's mean OWT validation NMSE (M0 table)
sources.noise: x + eta, ||eta_i|| = ||x_i - x_hat_i||, isotropic, 200 draws; frozen linear probes only

probes.frozen: original logistic (StandardScaler + L2, C from {0.01,0.1,1} by 3-fold grouped CV on train x) and mass-mean direction, applied unchanged
probes.refit: logistic (same C procedure on the source), MLP 768-64-1 (3 inits, scores averaged), kNN k=15 (standardised), sparse-z logistic on SAE codes (MaxAbs scaled, C by grouped CV); original counterparts fitted identically on x; sparse-z is compared with the original logistic
probes.error_term: frozen original logistic direction a on e = x - x_hat alone; identity a.x = a.x_hat + a.e checked numerically
probes.learning_curve: logistic at 50 % of train groups vs 100 %

metrics: AUROC on validation (higher better); gap = AUROC(original) - AUROC(source), lower better; 1000 paired grouped bootstrap resamples over validation statements, identical across sources of one task and layer
labels: src/evaluation/information_levels.py:label_cell, rules exactly as in the M0-M5 plan refinement 3 (tolerance 0.02; 'Not recovered' requires all 4 families reduced, all original family AUROC >= 0.75, no sample-inefficiency (source gains >= 0.02 from 50->100 % while original gains < 0.01), and SAE refit-logistic gap > PCA's at matched NMSE). Cells with original refit-logistic AUROC < 0.60 are 'Uninformative'. Displacement flag: error-term AUROC CI low > 0.5. 'Irrecoverable' is never claimed.

hypotheses.H2a: SAE frozen gap > noise frozen gap (logistic and mass-mean): one-sided paired bootstrap p; BH over the 108 SAEs per task
hypotheses.H2b: SAE refit-logistic gap vs PCA at matched NMSE: one-sided p for SAE better and for SAE worse; BH over 108 per task

sparsity_width: task-prompt L0 and live latents (M0) reported per cell; within-layer Spearman of gaps vs task L0, live latents and task error (descriptive); PCA reference is matched on error, not L0
smoke_test_disclosure: Ran on layers 0 and 6, seed 42, PCA from 5 chunks, in a scratch directory to check mechanics; label counts for those 18 cells were printed. One change followed: PCA k is matched on OWT validation NMSE instead of train eigenvalues (the smoke PCA overshot the target 0.17 vs 0.05). No rule or threshold was changed.
